name: run_video_preset
description: Build a CLI command for applying one evuedit color preset to a video or a folder of videos. Exactly one of file and input_dir must be non-null. Folder mode applies the selected preset to each supported video; the CLI accepts a filename ending in .mp4 as output base.

file.description: One input video path. Set null when input_dir is provided.

input_dir.description: Folder of videos for batch processing. Set null when file is provided.

output.description: Output MP4 filename. In folder mode this supplies the required .mp4 output extension/base.

input_profile.description: Optional input color profile override; null uses the catalog default.

profile_lut.description: Optional local Samsung Log to Rec.709 .cube LUT path. Required when the effective input profile is samsung-log.
